text: <yellow>Negator:</> Andy{br}<yellow>Type:</> Self-targeting Compulsory-activation{br}<yellow>Detail:</> Negates any and everything that puts him near death. He still has a sense of pain.

title: Unluck
text: <yellow>Negator:</> Fuuko Izumo{br}<yellow>Type:</> External-targeting Compulsory-activation{br}<yellow>Detail:</> Brings an unlucky event to any target that directly touches her bare skin. The scale of the event is determined by likability.

title: Untruth
text:
<yellow>Negator:</> Shen Xiang{br}<yellow>Type:</> External-targeting Compulsory-activation{br}<yellow>Detail:</> Once he looks at his target, it forces the target to reverse their thoughts and actions.
<yellow>Detail:</> Shen's often seen winking because blinking with both eyes cuts off the distribution of his ability, so he makes it a habit to only close one eye at a time.
